description_expanded: The Derby at the Beach - Pet-Friendly Luxury Vacation Rental on 30A with Private Pool and Beachview Favorite Features: - Private Pool (Heat Available) - In-House Elevator - Rooftop Terrace - Pets Allowed  - 2 Living Rooms - Gulf View More about The Derby at the Beach: Welcome to The Derby at the Beach, a luxurious 6-bedroom, 6-bathroom retreat in Dune Allen Beach, just a short stroll from the Gulf’s pristine shores. Designed for comfort and elegance, this pet-friendly escape features a private, heat-optional pool, an elevator, and an expansive rooftop terrace with breathtaking views. The outdoor retreat at The Derby at the Beach is designed for relaxation and entertaining. The private pool offers a refreshing escape, surrounded by ample space for sunbathing or unwinding in the shade. The outdoor kitchen is a chef’s dream, featuring a built-in gas grill and a spacious prep area—perfect for poolside cookouts. Nearby, a secondary living room with a convenient kitchenette allows easy access to cool drinks for the pool. Lounge poolside, enjoy a family barbecue, or unwind on the spacious rooftop terrace with breathtaking Gulf views—ideal for sunset cocktails and stargazing. The gourmet kitchen at The Derby at the Beach is designed for both serious chefs and casual entertainers. Outfitted with high-end appliances, it features a commercial-grade refrigerator, a gas stove with a griddle, and double ovens, making it easy to prepare meals for large groups. The dual dishwashers and beverage cooler add extra convenience, while the spacious island provides plenty of prep space and seating. Whether you're whipping up a seafood feast or just enjoying morning coffee, this kitchen is the heart of the home. The six luxurious bedrooms ensure a restful stay, featuring five king suites with spa-like en-suite bathrooms and quality linens for ultimate comfort. The rooftop terrace offers a serene escape with panoramic Gulf views, perfect for enjoying morning coffee or evening relaxation while taking in breathtaking sunsets. Exploring 30A is effortless with bikes included. Take a quick ride to nearby restaurants, shops, and scenic trails, or enjoy a leisurely five-minute walk to the beach for sun-soaked days on the sugar-white sand. This home perfectly blends luxury and convenience, ensuring every moment is unforgettable. Finish your stay with a photo finish—where luxury, relaxation, and Gulf views meet at The Derby at the Beach! Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: King Bed with Patio Access & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 2: King Bed with Patio Access & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. THIRD FLOOR Bedroom 3: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Shared Balcony & Gulf View. Bedroom 4: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Shared Balcony & Gulf View. Bedroom 5: 2 Twin over Twin Bunk Beds.  Bedroom 6: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. Additional Arrangements:  Futon
